title: Graphical Representation and Consistency — Pair of Linear Equations in Two Variables
hook: Let's explore Graphical Representation and Consistency from the chapter on Pair of Linear Equations in Two Variables. This is an important concept in NCERT Class 10 Mathematics that builds your foundation for higher studies!
explanation:
Graphical Representation and Consistency A pair of linear equations can be represented as two lines on a graph. The lines may intersect (unique solution), be parallel (no solution), or coincide (infinite solutions). Key Ideas to Master:
💡 Intersecting lines: a₁/a₂ ≠ b₁/b₂ → unique solution (consistent)
💡 Parallel lines: a₁/a₂ = b₁/b₂ ≠ c₁/c₂ → no solution (inconsistent)
💡 Coincident lines: a₁/a₂ = b₁/b₂ = c₁/c₂ → infinite solutions (dependent)
💡 Solution of pair = coordinates of point of intersection
